long_markdown_pdf_fix_20261014.summary: PDF renders long Markdown page by page, recursively slicing oversized blocks and text ranges so a single giant list/table/quote/code block is not recopied whole on each page. Ordered list numbering stays continuous across pages. Page ranges are planned before rendering so progress totals include keep-together early breaks accurately. Progress is live; timeout scales with actual planned page count and caps at 15 minutes. A stalled html2canvas page races job cancellation so lock, editor close, file switch, and timeout settle the export. PNG remains a single long image with a 10,000 CSS-pixel cap.
evidence: node scripts/markdown-download-export.test.js (includes a four-page keep-together fixture and a stalled-render cancellation case)
long_markdown_pdf_fix_20261014.browser: Native system Safari loaded the current markdown-export.js and bundled html2canvas 1.4.1/jsPDF 4.2.1 on a loopback-only stress page. A 4,000-item single ordered-list fixture downloaded as long-list-9.pdf; Safari Downloads showed 41.7 MB and pdfinfo confirmed 104 A4 pages, 41,731,707 bytes, Creator aide, Producer jsPDF 4.2.1. The last page was rendered and visually checked: items 3,988–4,000 appear with continuous numbering and no overlap. After an explicitly authorized start.command restart, the authenticated Aide file view's real Export → PDF control downloaded ROS2编译工程创建步骤_kunlun_ws-5.pdf; pdfinfo confirmed 74 A4 pages, 1,256,174 bytes, Creator aide. The Aide restart/build also completed go vet and image build. Peak memory and arbitrary-size behavior remain unmeasured.
long_markdown_pdf_fix_20261014.release: Implementation and documentation were pushed in ace6c94 after the 4,000-item Safari stress case and authenticated Aide file-view export passed. Peak-memory measurement and arbitrary-size limits are not established.
